comment: form exhibits fusion (morphophonology) in (at least) one of the morphemes
form has one category marked multiple times (multiple exponence)
form exhibits a tone alternation triggered by the stem
form contains morphemes that can variably order
form does not contain a marker for future tense (that is there in other forms with the same scenario)
form does not contain a marker for plural (that is there in other forms with the same scenario)
form is a hortative (not from declarative paradigm)
form is not used in special contexts
